title: Doors — Fwd Cargo Door Latching — Load-Sharing Carriage Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Retrofit of the load-sharing roller carriage at the forward cargo door, spreading the closing load across all eight hooks and removing the spurious door indications that follow one-sided hook wear.

sections.planning_reason: Shop findings showed that the two hooks closest to the actuator carry a 2.4 to 1 share of the closing load, wearing on one flank only. Sixty-one hook replacements were recorded across the fleet in eighteen months and the resulting hook profile change produced spurious door-not-locked indications on push-back at eight operators, each of which becomes a departure delay. This Service Bulletin brings delivered aircraft to the production standard cut in at MSN S01361.
sections.description: A compliant roller carriage is installed between the latch shaft and the hook at each of the eight stations. The right-hand latching web kit is replaced by an item with the carriage rail integral, an inboard shear tie is added at each hook station to react the rail load, and the outboard skin panel is re-drilled locally. The proximity target plate is moved 8 mm outboard so that the sensing gap is measured on the carriage rather than on the hook.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the forward cargo door and put the safety struts in position. WARNING: DO NOT WORK UNDER THE DOOR WITHOUT THE SAFETY STRUTS INSTALLED. Do AMM-S-52-30-13-000-004-A to remove the eight latch hooks and the existing latching web kit D5230136217763. Do a detailed visual inspection of the door frame at each hook station and record any finding. Install the inboard shear ties GRA7840-60 at each station and re-drill the outboard skin panel HOD355133-89 to the new pattern using the drill jig. Do an eddy current inspection of each re-drilled hole. Install the latching web kit with the carriage rail and set the carriage travel to the value given in the accomplishment instructions. Do AMM-S-52-30-13-400-004-A to install the eight latch hooks. Move the proximity target plate 8 mm outboard and set the sensing gap. Re-clip the door harness with cable ties LN309661K1 clear of the carriage travel. Do the carriage travel check of AMM-S-52-30-13-200-005-A. Do the door operational test including three full close and open cycles with the warning system live, and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft from MSN S00003 to MSN S01336 that have not been brought to the load-sharing standard. Aircraft from MSN S01361 onward are post-modification in production. One aircraft is excluded because it carries a non-standard door frame. Aircraft that embodied the cancelled corrosion-resistant hook Service Bulletin SLN-52-1024 may be modified directly with no rework of the bushed bores.
sections.material_note: Kit K5230-1043-01 contains the latching web kit, the eight shear ties, the carriage set and the fasteners. Lead time is twenty weeks. The removed hooks are returned to Aeralis for wear measurement so that the fleet wear model stays current.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within 30 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

revision_history.reason: Eddy current inspection of re-drilled holes made mandatory; carriage travel value corrected at step 7; note added for aircraft previously modified under the cancelled bulletin
